Home âº Finance âº Britain's Octopus Energy acquires Danish automated power trader BD Energy Finance Britain's Octopus Energy acquires Danish automated power trader BD Energy Published by Global Banking & Finance Review Posted on September 1, 2026 1 min read Â· Last updated: September 1, 2026 Add as preferred source on Google Finance Banking Markets Quick Summary Octopus Energy has acquired Danish automated power trading startup BD Energy to enhance its quantitative and tech-driven energy trading capabilities while expanding its European renewables footprint. Table of Contents Octopus Energy's Strategic Acquisition of BD Energy Overview of the Acquisition Implications for European Renewable Energy Market Expansion of Technology-Driven Trading Capabilities Growth in Renewable Energy Capacity Reporting and Editorial Credits Octopus Energy Acquires Denmark's BD Energy for European Trading Tech Expansion Octopus Energy's Strategic Acquisition of BD Energy Overview of the Acquisition Sept 1 (Reuters) - Octopus Energy on Tuesday said it had acquired Danish startup BD Energy to boost its technology-driven trading capabilities, as it continues to expand its renewable energy capacity in Europe. Subscribe Key Takeaways Octopus Energyâs acquisition of BD Energy strengthens its algorithmic and automated power trading capacity in Europe, leveraging BD Energyâs expertise in intraday and spot electricity markets. ( bdenergy.dk ) BD Energy, founded in 2022 and based in Aarhus, Denmark, employs ~18â31 staff and has completed 1.8 million transactions, powering over 100,000 households annually. ( ownr.dk ) This strategic move complements previous Octopus investments in energy tech (e.g., KrakenFlex, Uplight) and underlines its continued expansion across Europe and the US through tech-led M&A. BD Energy is a Danish startup focused on automated power trading. What sector is Octopus Energy expanding in? Octopus Energy is expanding its renewable energy capacity in Europe.
